content:
Ruth: opened PR to add a PKCS#11 slot-mapping migration guide, an HSM firmware preflight checklist, and a short air-gapped CA rotation example. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2993
Ben: Nice. We get a lot of tickets where slot numbers changed after HSM firmware updates. Can we add a small compatibility note + a recommended sequence for rolling firmware?
Ruth: Yes  will include a compatibility matrix and a stepwise rollout: drain clients -> backup slot mapping -> upgrade HSM -> verify slots -> rotate clients.
Ivy: For customers who can't make a maintenance window, include a read-only slot mapping check and a non-disruptive verification command. I can paste a tiny SDK snippet for slot discovery.
Marta: Also add a note about PKCS#11 URI placeholders and avoid publishing real slot IDs or PINs. Recommend `PIN_PATH` and `SLOT_LABEL="<SLOT_LABEL>"` placeholders.
Ezra: For firmware preflight: include `redwood-hsm-agent --diag` output example and a small checklist: CPU, RAM, network MTU, and spare slot count. Some HSMs fail on low entropy after upgrade, so recommend checking /proc/sys/kernel/random/entropy_avail.
Ben: Good call. Also suggest `ssh` health checks to the HSM management interface (if present) and sample SNMP OID to monitor firmware version (generic placeholder).
Ivy: SDK snippet (python) for slot enumeration using PyKCS11 (keep it tiny):
```
from PyKCS11 import PyKCS11Lib
lib = PyKCS11Lib()
lib.load('/usr/lib/libkcs11.so')  # adjust path
slots = lib.getSlotList(tokenPresent=True)
for s in slots:
    print('slot:', s)
```
Ivy: Note: run as root or ensure your user can access the device; replace the module path with the vendor library.
Ruth: For the migration guide, I'll add a short JSON-ish mapping example showing how to convert old numeric slots to label-based config (placeholders only).
Marta: Air-gapped CA rotation sample would be great  can you show how to create a new CA cert, sign it with an offline root, produce a chain, and import on Debian and RHEL?
Ezra: Draft openssl commands for signing and chain assembly:```
# generate new CA key/cert (airgapped machine)
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -out new-ca.key -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:4096
openssl req -new -x509 -days 3650 -key new-ca.key -out new-ca.crt -subj "/CN=Redwood-Local-CA"
# sign with offline root (on an offline signing host)
openssl x509 -req -in csr.pem -CA root-ca.crt -CAkey root-ca.key -CAcreateserial -out new-ca-signed.crt -days 3650
# assemble chain
cat new-ca-signed.crt root-ca.crt > full-chain.crt
```
Ezra: Debian import: `sudo cp full-chain.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ && sudo update-ca-certificates` 
Ezra: RHEL import: `sudo cp full-chain.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ && sudo update-ca-trust extract`
Marta: Add a step to rotate the CA on the redwood services gracefully: import new CA, wait for client cert reissuance, then flip active CA. Include rollback steps.
Ruth: Will add a small timeline/sequence and include checks like curl with `--cacert` and `--resolve` to validate in airgapped DNS scenarios.
Ben: Also add a short troubleshooting section: if clients fail after CA rotation, check trust store, check TLS handshake with `openssl s_client -showcerts -connect hsm:23456`, check systemd logs for redwood-hsm-agent and proxy.
Ivy: One more SDK snippet (go) for a label-based key lookup to nudge teams away from numeric slots:```
package main
import (
  "fmt"
  rw "github.com/redwood/sdk"
)
func main(){
  c := rw.NewClient("https://kms.internal")
  key, _ := c.LookupKeyByLabel("redwood-hsm-key")
  fmt.Println(key.ID)
}
```
Marta: Editorial: standardize headings to "HSM" and use "PKCS#11" capitalization. Also mention not to ship private keys or PINs in examples.

Ruth: Pushing a commit to add the missing anchor and a small compatibility table. Also scrubbing any literal slot numbers.
DocsBot: CI: linkcheck passed. Lint warnings: heading levels in pkcs11-migration.md (warnings only).

DocsBot: CI: all checks passed. Ready to merge.
Ben: Can you backport a short note to release/1.2.x that warns older installers about label-vs-slot config differences? That avoids surprises for support.
Ruth: Yep adding a one-line backport and a changelog bullet: "docs: add PKCS#11 slot-mapping migration guide, HSM firmware preflight checklist, and air-gapped CA rotation example (backported to v1.2)"
Marta: Thanks. I'll run a quick review for wording and security redaction.
Ruth: Pushed final edits and merged after Marta LGTM. Closing thread.
